basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 10.' and it opens 'Vers. 10. Non vocaberis ultra Jacob. Ipsa pene verba quae angelus dixerat, dixit et'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 10. Non vocaberis ultra Jacob. Ipsa pene verba quae angelus dixerat, dixit et Dominus; non tamen tunc vocatus est Israel, sed praedictum est ei quod ita vocandus esset. Quod ergo ibi praedictum est, hic est impletum.
